title: Companions who never got to finish their personal quest (Tamsin's mine, Vell's Marrowgate ledger, Perrin's mother) still get closing epilogue lines describing them as unresolved, but there is no in-game signal earlier that these threads were about to be permanently left open once I reached the Hollow Throne room (the room's own text does warn 'what you have left undone elsewhere stays undone', which is good, but it applies retroactively to a lot of threads at once with no per-thread confirmation).
